description: This file defines the Crunched formatter class used for formatting SCSS code in a minified, compressed style within the SCSSPHP project. It extends the base Formatter class and provides specific implementations for outputting compact CSS blocks and selectors.

classes.name: Crunched
classes.description: A formatter class intended for producing minified, compressed CSS output, marked as deprecated in favor of the 'Compressed' formatter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with specific indentation and separator settings; also triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines of a given output block, removing comment lines and handling line breaking and indentation.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors for a CSS block, replacing space-based combinators with their symbolic counterparts and wrapping with open brace.
